_comment: Teams a charter can staff. init.py --teams picks which agents are stamped; skills and the record CLI are shared. Unstaffed roles are not stamped, so they cost nothing per session.

core.description: Runs every project: orchestration, product, architecture, QA, learning, review, engineering, verification, docs and record keeping.

research.description: Market and technical research before the charter. Staff when the brief has open questions about users, market or feasibility.

design.description: Visual direction, design system, mockups for the design gate, UI implementation and visual QA. Staff for any project with a user interface; the design gate is then mandatory unless the CEO waives it.
